# AudioVisualizer — Frequency bars > A frequency spectrum with alignment, mirroring, idle, and loading options. Status: beta. This file matches the installed `audio-visualizer-bar` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/audio-visualizer-bar.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/audio-visualizer-bar.md`. ## Registry dependencies - `audio-visualizer` - `core` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/audio-visualizer-bar`: `AudioVisualizer`, types `BarAudioVisualizerProps` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { AudioVisualizer } from "@/components/control-ui/audio-visualizer-bar"; import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography"; import { useDemoAudioLevels } from "@/src/registry/examples/control-ui/audio-visualizer-demo"; const alignments = ["center", "start", "end"] as const; const idleModes = ["static", "pulse", "wave"] as const; export function AudioVisualizerBarExample() { const levels = useDemoAudioLevels("bands"); return (
{alignments.map((align) => (
{align}
))}
{idleModes.map((idle) => (
{idle}
))}
loading
); } ``` ## Anatomy Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`. - `audio-visualizer` - `bar`: `data-index` (any value) - `root`: `data-active`, `data-align` (any value), `data-idle` (any value), `data-loading`, `data-mirrored`, `data-variant` (`bar` | `bars` | `line`) - `track`: `data-active` ## Knobs Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin. ### audio-visualizer - `--cui-audio-visualizer-bar-size`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 1)` - `--cui-audio-visualizer-bar-gap`: `1px` - `--cui-audio-visualizer-radius`: `var(--radius-control)` - `--cui-audio-visualizer-bar-radius`: `var(--radius-control)` - `--cui-audio-visualizer-bar-background`: `oklch(from var(--primary) l c h / 0.8)` - `--cui-audio-visualizer-line-fill`: `oklch(from var(--primary) l c h / 0.18)` - `--cui-audio-visualizer-line-stroke`: `oklch(from var(--primary) l c h / 0.8)` - `--cui-audio-visualizer-baseline-stroke`: `oklch(from var(--border) l c h / 0.55)` - `--cui-audio-visualizer-animation-duration`: `calc(var(--duration-slow) * 4)` ## Links - Online docs (latest release): https://control-ui.dev/kits/audio-visualizer?alternative=bar - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/audio-visualizer.json
